acceptance: Red first: a full bundle becomes a thin bundle that verifies
Red first: a leaf with untracked files stays
Red first: over the cap, an unlanded leaf younger than the TTL stays
fix: K5: keep salvage_ttl_days, and add a size cap that evicts only landed leaves (tip in origin/main), the oldest first; write a thin bundle before a ref with unlanded work is dropped. K6: fetch each full bundle into a temporary ref, write a thin bundle, verify list-heads, replace, drop the temporary ref; keep the full leaf on each failure. Delete a leaf only when its tip is in origin/main, it has no uncommitted patch and no non-empty untracked archive. Never while a continuation binds the cycle.
summary: Plan PR #1585, checks K5, K6, component X6. It replaces the item gc-salvage-bundles-hold-the-whole-history-with-no-retention. On 2026-11-20, 206 legacy leaves held about 135 GB.
title: Salvage leaves get a size cap and the legacy full bundles become thin bundles
